decisions.reason: Having survived the 2019 portfolio review, this multi-model dental line has accumulated investment and portfolio visibility, so management is likely to continue backing it unless results are clearly poor.

As a lower-visibility accessory product with weaker strategic importance to the firm's digital-growth narrative, it is the easiest remaining item to discontinue once several years have passed without strong evidence of success.

Its dedicated visibility and close connection to digital dental workflows make withdrawal harder to justify, so management would tend to persist and treat any weakness as manageable within the broader strategy.
